ai.prompt:
Please revise the HTML slides below according to the comments.

Rules
- Modify only the areas indicated by comments. Keep all other slides, text, and layout intact.
- Preserve the slide structure (<section> tags) and scripts.
- Remove the <script id="he-comments"> block at the end after editing.
- Return the complete revised HTML file and provide a one-line summary of changes per slide.

Comments ({n})
{lines}

--- HTML Start ({file}) ---
{html}
--- HTML End ---
ai.promptDoc:
Please revise the HTML document below according to the comments.

Rules
- Modify only the areas indicated by comments. Keep all other sections, copy, and layout intact.
- Preserve document HTML structure, styles, and scripts.
- Remove the <script id="he-comments"> block at the end after editing.
- Return the complete revised HTML file and provide a brief summary of changes.

Comments ({n})
{lines}

--- HTML Start ({file}) ---
{html}
--- HTML End ---
ai.promptNoHtml:
Please revise the attached HTML file according to the comments below.

Rules
- Modify only the areas indicated by comments. Keep all other sections, copy, and layout intact.
- Preserve file structure, styles, and scripts.
- Remove the <script id="he-comments"> block at the end after editing.
- Return the complete revised HTML file and provide a brief summary of changes.

{lines}
